claim_boundary.allowed: finite-cutoff pure-loss encoding--noise Petz/theorem interval, small-cutoff primal/dual SDP certificate, cutoff/energy sensitivity, and explicitly schedule-mismatched sBs diagnostic
forbidden: Petz bound as a per-shot MAP decoder or deployable controller
arbitrary recovery as an implementable sBs pulse sequence
actual interleaved sBs as a certified feasible point of the terminal-recovery SDP
teacher/student lifetime minus one-cycle channel fidelity
ancilla/device noise, hardware timing, experimental fidelity or LER claim
